verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centered vertical stack and spacing, and works fine in the wider 614×768 canvas. Its flaws are minor: wide empty side margins, a centered banner that no longer overlaps the right planet the way it did in the original, and legal text that is still tiny. B breaks the hierarchy in several ways. The headline wraps to an orphaned 'last'. The legal line is pulled up between the subcopy and the CTA at almost subcopy size, competing with the message. The text block is crammed with no breathing room. The oversized CTA sits close to the bottom edge, and the banner is shoved into the top-left corner, cut loose from the logo and product.
